(C) 형용사를 취해 ‘~하게 느끼다, ~한 느낌이 나다’라는 뜻으 로 쓰이는 감각 동사 feel의 보어 자리로, 형용사 safe는 1음절 이고 –e로 끝나므로 –r을 붙여 만든 비교급 safer가 적절하다.

body:
Hello, everyone! I’m Yuna, and I’m the leader of
Warm Hearts, a club at our school. Our club has
solved some problems in our school and our
community over the past few years. I want to share
our stories.
One day, our school principal announced, “Our
students often take too much food and waste it at
lunchtime. How can we reduce food waste?”
The members of Warm Hearts gathered to solve
this problem. We thought that adding lines to food
trays would be helpful. Students could look at the
lines and take the right amount of food.
Our school principal liked this idea, so he changed
the food trays in the cafeteria. It was a success!
The new trays reduced a large amount of food
waste!
After we solved this problem at our school, we
started to look for problems in our community. We
found out that some roads around our school were
very dark at night. We all agreed that the roads
needed more lights. With the help of a teacher, we
put
up
lights
with
sensors
around
the
neighborhood. Now all our neighbors feel safer
than before!
Have you ever used a digital kiosk before? You
may think it’s easy. But some people have trouble
using kiosks.
To help them, we volunteered as digital guides at
the community center. We explained every step of
ordering: starting an order, choosing from the
menu, and paying.
After the class, people said, “Now we feel more
comfortable with kiosks. Thank you so much!” We
felt very proud.
As you can see, your actions can make positive
changes. Even the smallest acts can make a big
difference!

Welcome to the School Heroes Awards! I’m the
student president, Eunho Choi. During the school
day, we see our friends and teachers most of the
time. But there are other people who play roles
behind the scenes! Today, we have awards to
present to three of these heroes.
Drum roll, please! The first winner is the facilities
manager, Mr. Kim! He takes care of our school
buildings. Do you remember last summer? Some air
conditioners broke down, and it became very hot.
However, Mr. Kim came right away and fixed them.
He works hard to make our school a great place
for studying.
“I love working for our students. If you have a
question about the school facilities, feel free to ask
me!”
- Mr. Kim
The next award goes to … the leader of the
cafeteria staff, Ms. Lee! Many students say our
school lunches are the best. Ms. Lee prepares fresh
and delicious meals for us every day. At lunchtime,
she serves us food with a big smile. After the
students leave the cafeteria, she washes the dishes
and cleans the cafeteria.
“I’m happy when students enjoy their lunches. I’m
proud to serve delicious and healthy food.”
- Ms. Lee
Now it’s time to announce our final winner. It’s
our security officer, Mr. Park. Who do you see first
when you enter the school gate? It’s Mr. Park. He
makes sure we can walk to school safely in the
morning. During the day, he walks around the
school to check for any dangerous situations. We
can feel safe and focus on studying thanks to him!
“Thank you for this wonderful award. I will do my
best to keep you safe at school.”
- Mr. Park

choices: ⓔ: 잠드는 데 어려움을 겪을 수 있습니다
solution:
1. ⓓ keeps your brain active는 'keep+목적어+형용사(~을 …한 상태로 유지하다)' 구조이다.
2. 따라서 '여러분의 뇌를 활동적인 상태로 유지합니다'가 알맞고, '뇌가 활동하는 것을 막습니다'는 정반대의 뜻이다.
3. ⓐ 수동태(~에 의해 질문되었다), ⓑ matter(중요하다), ⓒ put down(내려놓다), ⓔ have trouble -ing(~하는 데 어려움을 겪다)는 모두 알맞다.
따라서 답은 ④이다.
